text:
Agent conduct:
- Never infer authorization; act only on explicit permission.
- Unknown ≠ exempt: NOT_APPLICABLE (no obligation exists; permits) and COULD_NOT_CHECK (could not observe whether the obligation was met; blocks) never collapse into each other. A check that could not observe reports COULD_NOT_CHECK, never PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE.
- Conventions (e.g. pattern conventions) are guidance for agents, not independent enforcement; existing plan and source validators still apply.

coverage.note: Bullet 2: Unknown ≠ exempt, NOT_APPLICABLE vs COULD_NOT_CHECK semantics (permits/blocks), unobservable check reports COULD_NOT_CHECK never PASS/NOT_APPLICABLE.
Bullet 3: conventions are guidance not enforcement; existing plan and source validators still apply.

notGeneric.content: Specific reference to journey-strategy *pattern* conventions (cached strategy patterns) being guidance only; the generic node states the principle for conventions in general.

variants.note: Canonical bullet 1 explicitly preserves never inferring authorization.

Canonical bullet 2 preserves the distinction between NOT_APPLICABLE (no obligation; permits) and COULD_NOT_CHECK (unable to observe; blocks), prohibits conflating them, and requires unobservable checks to report COULD_NOT_CHECK rather than PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE.

Canonical bullet 3 explicitly includes pattern conventions as guidance for agents rather than independent enforcement and retains existing plan and source validators. The journey-strategy-specific context is also recorded in notGeneric.

audit.summary: All three variants are fully carried by the canonical text; no knowledge is partial or lost. canonical.json and variants.json were not modified.
